name: Anastasia to 7-nin no Himegami ~Inmon no Rakuin~
original_name: アナスタシアと7人の姫女神 ～淫紋の烙印～
source:
The Kingdom of Asgard, the central nation of planet Earth, is ruled by the chief god Odin, his family, and their vassals—the Aesir gods.

Famed for their bravery and beauty is the Valhalla Corps, led by the goddess Anastasia.
It is composed of divine women such as the first princess, Brunhild.
Even the enemy nation of Niflheim, home of the giants opposing Asgard, had been effortlessly repelled time and again thanks to the goddesses' valor.

However, the balance of power is disrupted by Loki—a hideous man, born of both human and godly blood.

This man, consumed by inferiority complexes, begins to dominate the minds of the goddesses using the <Hack> ability bestowed upon him by the giants.

One by one, the goddesses fall.
Their wombs and breasts are branded with lewd symbols,
assaulted by vile men and monsters, impregnated,
and ultimately betray their kings and fiancés—!
translation:
阿斯加德王国是地球的中心国家，由主神奥丁、他的家人和他们的封臣——阿萨诸神统治。

由女神阿纳斯塔西娅领导的瓦尔哈拉军团以其勇敢和美丽而闻名。
由第一公主布伦希尔德等神圣女性组成。
即使是与阿斯加德对抗的巨人的故乡尼福尔海姆的敌国，也因女神们的英勇而一次又一次被毫不费力地击退。

然而，力量的平衡被洛基打破了——洛基是一个丑陋的人，同时拥有人类和神灵的血统。

这个被自卑感吞噬的男人，开始利用巨人赋予他的<Hack>能力来统治女神们的思想。

女神一一陨落。
她们的子宫和胸部都烙有淫秽的符号，
被卑鄙的人和怪物袭击，怀孕，
最终背叛了他们的国王和未婚夫——！
